macro_markets.query: What are the most important macroeconomic and stock market news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include major index movements, Fed/central bank news, and significant company earnings or announcements.

crypto_news.query: What are the most significant cryptocurrency and blockchain news from the past 24 hours? Include major price movements, regulatory news, and notable project developments.

items.title: Bitcoin and Ether edge higher as the crypto market steadies
items.summary: Bitcoin traded around the low-to-mid $63,000 range and Ethereum near $1,900, with the broader crypto market cap hovering around $2.2 trillion to $2.24 trillion over the past day. Several market recaps also noted mixed performance across major altcoins, with Bitcoin and Ether modestly up while some assets such as Cardano and other altcoins lagged.

items.title: Bitcoin trading range remains tight despite ETF flow support
items.summary: Market coverage highlighted that U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs have seen a recent stretch of net inflows, suggesting institutional demand remains supportive even as price action stays range-bound. The flows were described as one of the strongest stretches since May.

items.title: Compound approves $52 million institutional DeFi program
items.summary: Compound Finance approved a large institutional-focused DeFi initiative, signaling a strategic shift toward real-world assets, partnerships, and traditional financial-market credit infrastructure. The move was one of the most notable project developments reported in the last 24 hours.

items.title: Binance reportedly plans UK return with FCA license bid
items.summary: Reports said Binance is preparing to re-enter the UK market through a licensing push with the Financial Conduct Authority. If completed, the move would mark a significant regulatory and business development for one of the largest global exchanges.

items.title: Coinbase secures approval for international tokenization platform
items.summary: Coinbase reportedly obtained approval for an international tokenization platform, reflecting growing momentum around regulated tokenization infrastructure. The development adds to a broader wave of institutional blockchain adoption news.

items.title: SEC vote on crypto startup registration exemption draws attention
items.summary: Market reports said the SEC scheduled a vote on a registration exemption intended for crypto startups, though related regulatory activity was also described as subject to last-minute changes. The item underscores continued U.S. regulatory focus on digital assets.

items.title: South Korea's Jeonbuk Bank taps Ripple for cross-border payments
items.summary: Cointelegraph reported that Jeonbuk Bank in South Korea is using Ripple for cross-border payments, adding to Ripple’s banking and payments footprint. The development is a notable project and adoption story in blockchain payments.

items.title: Harmony plans rollback after ONE exploit
items.summary: Cointelegraph reported that Harmony is considering a rollback to reverse roughly 109,000 transactions after an exploit affecting ONE. The incident is one of the clearest security-related project developments in the latest news cycle.

items.title: Bits of Gold breach exposes 200,000 customers
items.summary: A market recap reported a security breach at Israel’s top crypto broker, Bits of Gold, that exposed about 200,000 customers. The incident stands out as a major crypto industry security and regulatory concern.

items.title: Moscow Exchange plans crypto futures expansion
items.summary: One market recap said Moscow Exchange is preparing Bitcoin and Ethereum perpetual futures and may later expand coverage to as many as ten assets. This would be a notable product expansion in regulated crypto derivatives.

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Fortnite confirms a gaming crossover season with Sonic, Shadow, Sora, Mega Man, Pac-Man, Spyro, Crash Bandicoot, and Persona 5’s Joker
items.summary: Epic Games officially revealed Fortnite’s next gaming-themed season, called Override, which begins on August 20 and centers on video game crossovers.

items.title: Helldivers 2 arrives in the PlayStation Plus catalog today for Extra and Premium subscribers
items.summary: Sony added Helldivers 2 to the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog, making the shooter available to subscribers on Extra and Premium tiers.

items.title: Netflix is shutting down two game studios
items.summary: Netflix is reportedly closing two internal game studios, including Night School Studio despite the acclaim for Unhinged.

items.title: A US Senate subcommittee opens an investigation into Roblox over child safety concerns
items.summary: Lawmakers have started a formal probe into Roblox, focusing on allegations and broader concerns around child safety on the platform.

items.title: Mortal Shell II enters early access
items.summary: Indie gaming coverage highlighted Mortal Shell II as available in early access, adding to the day’s notable release news.

items.title: The Sinking City 2 launches for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S
items.summary: The survival horror sequel was noted as launching imminently across major platforms, making it one of the day’s notable release-related updates.

items.title: Kingdom Hearts IV reportedly targeting a late 2027 release
items.summary: A gaming news roundup discussed Square Enix’s resurfacing of Kingdom Hearts IV, with a late 2027 launch window mentioned.

items.title: Fortnite’s next season also ties into Disney theme park content
items.summary: Reporting around Fortnite’s new season said Disney is bringing Fortnite into real-world Star Wars rides, extending the game’s crossover reach beyond digital content.

items.title: Esports World Cup 2026 produces major results in PUBG Mobile, Rocket League, and Rainbow Six Siege
items.summary: Recent esports coverage highlighted S2G Esports winning PUBG Mobile, Team Falcons taking the Rocket League title, and FaZe Clan winning Rainbow Six Siege at the Esports World Cup.
